description: JPVerify: Japan business data for AI agents — verify Japanese companies (法人番号), qualified-invoice T-numbers (インボイス), invoice issuers (including registration on the invoice date) and suppliers; normalize and validate Japanese addresses; find a Japanese company from its English name; plus JP PINT e-invoice validation. Use when a task involves Japanese business documents or data and you need to pick the right check. Paid per call (API key credits or x402); a free guide tool is available.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
